## Online extras

::: {.tldr custom-style="tldr"}
Some pages belong only in the ebook and web editions, so the print build leaves them out.
:::

This page is listed in `build.print_exclude`, so the print interior and the Kindle file skip it while the [EPUB]{.smallcaps} and the web edition keep it. A page like this suits material that only works on a screen, such as a list of links a reader would tap.

::: {.exercise custom-style="exercise"}
Pick one page of your own book that only makes sense on a screen, and decide whether print readers lose anything without it.
:::
